title: Bicycle with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Wheels -->
  <circle cx="25" cy="70" r="18" fill="none" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="5"/>
  <circle cx="75" cy="70" r="18" fill="none" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="5"/>
  <!-- Spokes -->
  <line x1="25" y1="52" x2="25" y2="88" stroke="#FFA500" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="7" y1="70" x2="43" y2="70" stroke="#FFA500" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="12" y1="57" x2="38" y2="83" stroke="#FFA500" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="38" y1="57" x2="12" y2="83" stroke="#FFA500" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="75" y1="52" x2="75" y2="88" stroke="#FFA500" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="57" y1="70" x2="93" y2="70" stroke="#FFA500" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="62" y1="57" x2="88" y2="83" stroke="#FFA500" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="88" y1="57" x2="62" y2="83" stroke="#FFA500" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Hub centres -->
  <circle cx="25" cy="70" r="3" fill="#FF6B35"/>
  <circle cx="75" cy="70" r="3" fill="#FF6B35"/>
  <!-- Frame -->
  <line x1="25" y1="70" x2="50" y2="50" stroke="#FF6B35" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="50" x2="75" y2="70" stroke="#FF6B35" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="50" x2="40" y2="70" stroke="#FF6B35" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="25" y1="70" x2="40" y2="70" stroke="#FF6B35" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="40" y1="70" x2="75" y2="70" stroke="#FF6B35" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Handlebar stem -->
  <line x1="50" y1="50" x2="45" y2="38" stroke="#00CED1" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Handlebars -->
  <line x1="38" y1="36" x2="52" y2="38" stroke="#00CED1" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="36" r="2.5" fill="#00CED1"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="38" r="2.5" fill="#00CED1"/>
  <!-- Seat post -->
  <line x1="50" y1="50" x2="55" y2="40" stroke="#00CED1" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Seat -->
  <ellipse cx="55" cy="38" rx="8" ry="3.5" fill="#00CED1"/>
  <!-- Smiling face on the frame area -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="10" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  <circle cx="46" cy="55" r="2" fill="#1A1A2E"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="55" r="2" fill="#1A1A2E"/>
  <path d="M45 61 Q50 66 55 61" fill="none" stroke="#1A1A2E" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="59" r="2.5" fill="#FF6B8A" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="59" r="2.5" fill="#FF6B8A" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Pedal crank -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="70" r="4" fill="#FF6B35" stroke="#FFA500" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Pedals -->
  <line x1="35" y1="75" x2="40" y2="70" stroke="#00CED1" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="45" y1="65" x2="40" y2="70" stroke="#00CED1" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
